Commercial temporary fencing

Event Fence & Barricade Rental

Fencing for festivals, municipal events, corporate functions, and venues. We plan installation and pickup around load-in, opening, and load-out.

Request a quoteCall Richard(317) 296-4015
Setup & pickup
On your event schedule
Options
Panels, screen & barricades
Removal
Included in the quote

Start with the event footprint

Mark the public entrances, vendor areas, queues, backstage areas, and vehicle access on your plan. Panels can enclose the overall footprint, while barricades guide queues and separate activity areas.

Barricades are available on their own. You do not need to rent a full fence perimeter to order them.

Work to the production schedule

Tell Richard when the site becomes available, when doors open, and when the venue needs the space clear. We can set up overnight or before dawn and remove the fencing when the event ends.

Removal is included in the agreed quote. Share changes to the schedule so the crew and truck can be planned around them.

Make use of the perimeter

Windscreen can screen a service area or provide a surface for sponsor graphics. It comes plain or custom printed and is sold, not rented.

Our fencing has been used at sites including the NBA All Star Game Google Pixel Event, the Final Four, and White River State Park. These are project locations; the venues were not necessarily our direct customers.

Questions about this service

Can you remove fencing the night an event ends?

Yes. Include the load-out time when you request the quote so pickup can be scheduled.

Can our sponsors appear on the fence?

Yes. Custom printed windscreen can carry sponsor graphics. Send the artwork requirements and event date when planning the order.

What do you need to quote an event?

The location, event footprint, approximate fence or queue length, access points, and times for load-in, opening, and load-out.
